__comment_database: On-disk SQLite database used to durably mirror the device cache so it survives a restart. 'path' selects the file (defaults to '.warden.db' next to the service). 'check_same_thread' must stay false so warden's worker-thread pool can share the single connection, and 'timeout'/'busy_timeout_ms' control how long sqlite waits on a locked database.
__comment_device_ttl: Seconds after which an unseen device is pruned from both the cache and database. Defaults to 604800 (1 week).
